info.title: Clawfare HTTP API
info.description: Single-source HTTP contract for the local Ktor server, browser and authenticated read-only Sites adapter. Hosted mode exposes only informational GETs and zero-cost POST /api/estimate; all paid operations remain local-only and gated by local consent. Identity is provided by trusted Sites ingress, never by caller-supplied headers.
